title: Coalition talks nearing some result in Latvia
summary_full: The formation of the government is nearing completion – the United List still needs to reach agreement with the National Alliance on certain issues, as stated by Māris Kučinskis, chair of the United List parliamentary group, following a meeting with President Edgars Rinkēvičs on Friday, November 13.
